name: Annals of the Sage Eye
description: Shu Yun's private history, a set of scrolls recorded by Quan, partly hidden under Dirgur.

timeline.summary: Narset reads the Annals in the stronghold's depths, learning of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, but cannot decipher Ugin's runes.
timeline.quote: I learned that a dragon named Ugin was connected to Tarkir in ways the khans couldn't comprehend, and that some had claimed Ugin was gone, but not dead.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun dictates a history of Tarkir at Dirgur and prepares to receive the arriving khans at his unprecedented summit.
timeline.quote: This meeting, this council of khans, was Shu Yun's desperate effort to improve the odds of survival.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun takes the Annals scrolls from Quan to hide them and leaps from the window onto Silumgar's dragon, killing it with his tattooed palm.
timeline.quote: His dragon tattoo flashed with magical energy, and he slammed his palm into a very particular spot on the dragon's skull.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun hides the scroll case in a room beneath the stronghold and swallows the key.
timeline.quote: He shut the door, took the key, swallowed it with a shudder, and ran back to the courtyard.

pages_say.description: Ancient scrolls and relics in the lowest section of Sage Eye, dating back a thousand years and telling of the time of the dragons.
Shu Yun's private history, a set of scrolls recorded by Quan, partly hidden under Dirgur.
